title: List of evaluated wire values
statement: Let $w$ be a finite list of wires, each either an input position in $	ext{Fin}(N)$ or a Boolean constant, and let $v$ assign a Boolean value to each input position. The list obtained by evaluating each wire in $w$—using $v$ for input positions and the given value for constants—is the image of $w$ under this evaluation.
hypotheses_covered: A list w of wires in Fin(N) ⊕ Bool
